name: First World War
description: Industrialized attrition on continental scale: trenches from the Channel to Switzerland, artillery, gas, and roughly seventeen million dead. Four empires collapsed, the map of Europe and the Middle East was redrawn, and the unresolved peace incubated the next war.

name: Second World War
description: The deadliest conflict in history — perhaps seventy million dead — spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and every ocean, encompassing the Holocaust's industrial genocide and ending with atomic bombs, a divided Europe, and the United Nations.
